A [[Color|white]]-[[hair]]ed '''Talpiddian''' was a [[prison]]er of [[Silvo's pirates|Brutus's pirate crew]] who was kept in a brig in the underbelly of the [[asteroid]] [[Borgo Prime]].<ref name="SC 103" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> he<ref name="SC 103 AD" /> was electrocuted with an [[electro-shock prod]] by a [[Unidentified guard (electro-shock prod)|local guard]]. The incident was used by [[Jod Na Nawood]] as a distraction. With the guard attending to another inmate,<ref name="SC 103" /> the [[Gender|man]]<ref name="SC 102 ST">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}}</ref> was free to walk the [[Skeleton Crew]] [[youngling]]s across the hallway without being noticed, allowing them all to escape.<ref name="SC 103" />

==Behind the scenes==
The electrocuted [[Talpiddian]] debuted in the third episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', "[[Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem]],"<ref name="SC 103" /> which was aired on [[December 10]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
